en-US.name: GodotHub
en-US.releaseNotes:
What's new in v1.5.5
🚀 New
- New Vault: save files and folders from one or more projects as a reusable item with a name, description and tags, then add it to any project later. Adding to several projects at once is supported, and you get a prompt before existing files are overwritten
- Customize View is now a dropdown on the Projects page: switch between List, Grid and Kanban and toggle what shows on project cards (size, time tracked, session timer, path, tags, last opened, play and console buttons) without opening a separate dialog
- If a view fails to load, GodotHub now shows a message with a Retry button and technical details instead of a blank page. The rest of the app keeps working
- Drag pinned projects to reorder them. Their order is saved
- Ctrl/Cmd + click a project card to select it, or Shift + click to select a range. Selected cards get a blue outline instead of showing checkboxes, and the selection bar slides in and out
- Git: the Commit button shows a lock when the current branch is protected on GitHub or GitLab, and asks whether to commit anyway or move the changes to a new branch, push it, and open a pull request
🐛 Fixes
- Fixed the Customize View experimental button and several search UI bugs
- Fixed duplicate design tokens and small layout spacing issues across the app
- Fixed icons being stretched to the text height, which left many icons and labels misaligned
- Fixed the toggle knob sitting off-center, and checkboxes and some text not following the density and text size settings
- Fixed the sidebar collapse button icon being off-center
- Fixed project and version cards being cut off at the edges
- Fixed too little spacing under categories with no projects in Manage Categories
- fix support banner reappearing after it is dismissed. #258; PR by hanmi255
✨ Improvements
- Dialogs now keep keyboard focus inside them, close with Escape, and return focus to where you were when they close. Focus rings were also added to more controls for keyboard navigation
- The New Project button expands on hover, and the Sort and Filter buttons and the active tag filter chip are easier to read
- Consistent spacing across view panels, loading states, dropdowns and context menus, and standardized small text sizes
- Smoother performance: Godot download progress updates are throttled, the project console keeps only the latest 5000 lines and skips redundant updates, and the installed versions list no longer re-checks every 15 seconds
- Uninstalling a Godot version no longer freezes the app while files are being deleted
- Project scans use less disk access and only refresh the list when new projects are actually found
- Search Bar in Sidebar that opens command palette for easier access
- New and Improved Animations throughout the app
- Templates folder and Versions folder buttons in the Versions view
- Pick a category's color right from the new category name field
- Smoother project drag and drop: cards slide out of the way, the dragged card lifts and glides into place, and you can grab a card from anywhere instead of using a drag handle
- Less clutter: descriptions were removed from modal headers and settings, and each setting now sits on one line with its control
- Modals open faster, have larger titles, and no longer blur the app behind them
- Sidebar: Add Categories, 'You' Button, the GodotHub title moved to the titlebar, search sits at the top next to the collapse button, and tab labels fade in when you expand the sidebar
- Slider reset buttons only appear when a value differs from its default
- Revamped whole Onboarding experience
- Revamped Workspace creation experience
